known.via: English Wikipedia "Côtes de Bourg AOC" (redirects to "Côtes de Bourg")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Right Bank Bordeaux appellation around Bourg-sur-Gironde, on the east bank of the Gironde estuary, in the north of Bordeaux. The Romans planted the first vineyards. Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cot are among the grapes allowed.
